Personalized dental care for every smile

14912 Hull Street Road
Chesterfield, VA 23832
(804) 639-9622

Monday – Thursday: 8:00am – 5:00pm
Every Other Friday: 8:00am – 1:00pm

At Commonwealth Dentistry in Chesterfield, we focus on making every visit easy, comfortable, and tailored to your needs. Our friendly, skilled team is here to support your smile with high-quality care and a personalized approach.

From routine cleanings to advanced cosmetic treatments, we offer comprehensive dental services under one roof. Our Chesterfield location is designed to make your experience convenient, stress-free, and focused on long-term oral health.
Our Chesterfield dental services include:
We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.
We’re proud to provide an experience that puts you first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.
Our Chesterfield dentist office offers comprehensive general and cosmetic treatments in-office and works with other locations to provide specialty treatment.
Experiencing a dental emergency? We can generally see you the very same day to get you back to feeling like yourself.

A founding partner of Commonwealth Dentistry, Dr. Mark Beltrami graduated from MCV School of Dentistry in 1995 and has been practicing in the area since 1998. Besides his work at Commonwealth Dentistry, Dr. Beltrami also helped establish and is the current vice president of Central Virginia Dental Care, PLC. He is a member of the American Dental Association and has been invited as an expert for their informational panels. Mark is also a long-standing member of the Virginia Dental Association, where he has served on the new dentist committee and is an active member of the advisory board for Benchmark Dentures, the largest pro bono denture distributor for the VDA’s Mission of Mercy project.

Dr. Beltrami dedicates extensive time each year to participate in continuing dental education around the country and he has been recognized by “Best of the Tri-Cities” as Best Dentist by the Progress-Index. Mark has also traveled to Jamaica with dental students to serve communities on the island that have limited access to dental care. Outside the office, he has served as part-time faculty at the VCU School of Dentistry for more than 10 years and resides in the area with his wife, Michelle, and two children.
As recently as 2020, Dr. Mark Beltrami was selected by his peers as a Top General Dentist according to Richmond Magazine!

Dr. Alyssa Burton grew up in Hickory, NC, and moved to Virginia to complete her education and training. She earned her undergraduate degree in Biomedical Engineering from The University of Virginia before discovering her passion for dentistry through hands-on experience in her cousin’s practice. She earned her DDS from Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry and completed a General Practice Residency at Carilion Roanoke Memorial Hospital, where she gained experience treating medically complex patients and a wide range of dental needs. Dr. Burton is especially interested in root canals, extractions, anterior restorations, and restoring smiles after dental trauma. She is a member of the American Dental Association, Academy of General Dentistry, and Virginia Dental Association.

Known for her calm and easy-going demeanor, Dr. Burton is passionate about helping patients feel comfortable, informed, and confident in their care. She believes dentistry blends technical skill, creativity, and personal connection — and she finds fulfillment in transforming lives through healthy, confident smiles.

Outside the office, she enjoys hiking, playing soccer, reading in the park, and visiting National Parks — Mount Rainier being her favorite. After living in Virginia for over a decade, she’s proud to call it home.

A native of Dalton, GA, Dr. Meadows studied biology at The University of Georgia before earning his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from VCU School of Dentistry, where he was a recipient of the Elizabeth and Eugene Harrison Scholarship. He has trained in 3D printing and CADCAM dentistry, which is a field of advanced techniques in computerized dentistry.

Clint regularly participates in extensive continuing education opportunities with a focus on dental implant placement, root canal therapy, sedation, and esthetic dentistry. He is a member of the American Dental Education Association and the American Dental Association and participates in Mission of Mercy projects in Virginia where he provides free dental care to those in need.

Outside the office and his volunteer efforts, Clint is an avid musician and concert-goer. He plays bass, guitar, and piano, and regularly performs with a Richmond-area band composed of other local dentists. Dr. Meadows lives in Midlothian, VA with his wife, Julia, and their dog, Piper. They enjoy traveling, hiking, biking, seeing live music, and eating at new restaurants in the Richmond area.

At Commonwealth Dentistry in Chesterfield, we provide a wide range of services, including preventive exams, root canals, fillings, and cosmetic dentistry treatments designed to improve the health and appearance of your smile.

Yes, we accept most major dental insurance plans as well as many regional providers. If you don’t have insurance, we also offer an in-house discount plan and flexible options to help make dental care affordable.

Most patients should visit the dentist every 6 months for routine exams and professional cleanings. However, your dentist may recommend a different schedule depending on your oral health needs.
